name: Heard
summary: Done-for-you bookkeeping and taxes built for therapists and a growing range of health-and-wellness practices — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists: monthly books, quarterly tax estimates, annual filing and S-corp support by specialists who know the niche.
best_for: therapists and health-and-wellness practice owners — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists — who want books, quarterly estimates and filing handled by specialists who know their niche
skip_if: you are comfortable doing your own books in a general tool at a fraction of the price, or your business sits outside the health-and-wellness practice niche
honest_knock: Mind the fine print between tiers: the entry plan does not include your annual tax filing (a $750 add-on on Lite), month-to-month billing costs $20 to $50 a month more than the annual rate, and messy back-months cost extra as catch-up fees. Price the tier that actually includes filing.

plans.name: Lite
plans.includes: done-for-you bookkeeping and reports for solo sole proprietors; the annual tax return is a $750 add-on

plans.name: Essential (sole props)

plans.name: Essential (S corps or groups)

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-27 in a browser on joinheard.com/pricing and in joinheard.com/llms.txt, which says its prices are for new members starting October 26, 2026; earlier readings on 5 September and 6 October 2026 showed Lite at $129, Essential at $169 and Premium at $255 a month) Heard now prices by practice type, with annual and monthly billing. For solo sole proprietors: Lite is $139 a month billed annually ($1,668 a year) or $159 billed monthly, and Essential is $189 a month billed annually ($2,268 a year) or $219 billed monthly; the page puts the annual saving at $240 and $360 a year. For S corps and group practices, Essential is $299 a month billed annually or $349 monthly, per the llms.txt. Lite covers done-for-you bookkeeping and reports but not your annual tax return, which is a $750 add-on; Essential includes quarterly estimates and annual personal tax filing, and the S corp version adds the business return. Two costs sit outside the plan price: catch-up bookkeeping, required when you join, at $99 for each month you have been in business this year (on 27 October 2026 the page offered 2026 books caught up for free on an annual plan until 31 December), and payroll for S corps and group practices at $49 a month plus $9 per person, powered by Gusto. Heard bundles business banking at no extra cost; its llms.txt gives the rate as 1.00-2.50% APY, tiered, with FDIC insurance up to $3M through partner bank i3 Bank.

compare_with.name: Bench or a local CPA
compare_with.why: Bench wins on general small-business bookkeeping breadth, a good local CPA on complex situations; Heard wins on therapy-practice specialization and S-corp guidance
